value:
THE CLOSABILITY RE-RUN AGAINST THE SHIPPED STAGE, WITH THE CANARIES REPLAYED FIRST. BOTTOM LINE: CH's Tier-A-empty verdict was indeed a design artifact, but correcting it does NOT produce combined-stage exacts -- it produces PERMUTATION-COMPOSITION exacts. Four functions closed byte-exact this run and not one of them uses the combined stage at all.

METHOD, and the one thing that separates it from CH's: nothing is simulated. ch_closable.py wrote the TARGET WORD at each form site and then asked verify_consistent_recolor to adjudicate a word it did not produce, which is precisely the failure claim.law.WF_combined-stage-re-encodes-in-our-colouring-and-a-permutation-may-run-after-the-recolor.20260901.v1 diagnoses. hb_closable.py instead CALLS webfrank.equivalent_copy_form, webfrank.copy_register_fields and webfrank.verify_consistent_recolor in apply_patch's own order with the context apply_patch builds, and hb_compose.py proves the finished rule through webfrank.apply_patch itself against the extracted retail object. A CLEAN verdict here is a rule that will apply, and every rule shipped this run did.

CANARIES, MANDATED AND PASSED AT EVERY STAGE. (1) fn_800D8F28 -> CLEAN, and the derivation independently produced the shipped rule verbatim: equivalent_copy_form [{at 0xec, proof unconditional_recolor}] + copy_register_fields. (2) camera_mode_level -> the analyser reports 4 unabsorbed words and independently derives {at 0x8b0, proof constant_dataflow_recolor, our_source 30}, which is the shipped edit exactly; the Tier-B search then re-derives BOTH permutation windows from the bytes -- +0x740..+0x748 order [1,0] accepted PRE, and +0x8c0..+0x8c8 order [1,0] REFUSED pre with the identical string `breaks def-use chains: [(0, ('g', 4))]` recorded in WF's attempt and accepted POST -- and hb_compose.py reproduces the whole rule including both recorded hashes (before c8050a0e..., after aebb8256...). The composition, its placements and its refusals all replay. A scanner without a canary lies; this one does not.

THE MEASURED ROSTER. 2840 equal-size paired functions, 290 differing. TIER A (no permutation needed) = 93 functions, of which 70 pass verify_consistent_recolor and ALL 70 ARE ALREADY SHIPPED. Genuinely new Tier A payoff, image-wide, both halves: ZERO. TIER B (unabsorbed words that a permutation can absorb) = 49 functions where every unabsorbed cluster admits an order the real guards accept. Restricted to the HB half (TU >= game/n, minus the six TUs other lanes own this run) and to unshipped functions, 14 candidates composed and 4 reached target bytes through apply_patch: pb_diag::pbResetDiag, pb_texture::pbInitTlutRegions, ui/btext::DrawGlowTextMLines, ui/select::init_player_change. The 10 refusals are informative and are NOT stage gaps: 6 die at verify_consistent_recolor (4 inconsistent renaming, 2 'base register presence differs' -- the g0-vs-gNN bar CH already named as permanently out), 3 at relocation binding (a word relocated in the target but not in ours, or a differing relocation symbol -- the own-pool spelling class), 1 at a form site whose proof scan hits a relocated word. Every one of those is a pre-existing bar, not something the combined stage would have reached.

CONSEQUENCE FOR TRIAGE, stated plainly because it inverts the standing scoping. The combined stage's marginal contribution to EXACTS in this half is zero: it is necessary for none of the four closes. What produced all four is instruction_permutation composed with copy_register_fields -- a capability that has existed for runs. The 83-site combined population remains correctly prioritised BY SITES and remains a prerequisite for its carriers, but a lane sizing the next harvest should size PERMUTATION COMPOSITION, screen the un-widened cluster (see the companion law), and treat the combined stage as one mode among four rather than as the axis. This is the payoff inversion recurring a FOURTH time, now one level further down again: the axis with the most sites had the fewest closable functions, and the closes came from the oldest capability in the kit.
